intro: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita from CAVA delivers bold Mediterranean flavors in a handheld format. This signature item from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) features tender spiced lamb meatballs paired with cooling tzatziki and vibrant toppings. At 810 calories with 38g of protein, it offers a satisfying meal option for those seeking authentic Middle Eastern taste. Explore the [full CAVA menu](//) for more customizable options.
priceCalories: Priced between $13.95 and $14.95, the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita provides 810 calories per serving. The macronutrient breakdown includes 38g of protein, 66g of carbohydrates, and 44g of fat. This pricing positions it competitively within CAVA's curated pitas selection, offering premium lamb at a moderate price point compared to other protein options on the menu.
whatMakesSpecial: This pita stands out with its combination of spicy lamb meatballs seasoned with traditional Mediterranean spices. The cooling tzatziki balances the heat from the Hot Harissa Vinaigrette, while sumac cabbage slaw adds tangy crunch. Pickled onions provide acidity that cuts through the richness of the lamb. The interplay of spicy, creamy, and tangy elements creates a complex flavor profile unique among CAVA's offerings.
nutritionFacts: With 810 calories, this pita delivers substantial energy for an active lifestyle. The 38g of protein supports muscle maintenance and satiety, while 66g of carbohydrates provide fuel. The 44g of fat comes primarily from the lamb and tzatziki. For detailed nutritional breakdowns and customization options, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to adjust ingredients based on your dietary needs.
whatsInside: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita features warm pita bread filled with seasoned lamb meatballs as the protein base. Creamy tzatziki sauce adds Mediterranean authenticity, while sumac cabbage slaw brings purple color and citrusy notes. Pickled onions contribute bright acidity, and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette delivers the signature spice. Each ingredient from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) works harmoniously together.
tasteLike: Expect a bold, spicy flavor experience with layers of complexity. The lamb meatballs offer savory, slightly gamey richness with warming spices. Tzatziki provides cool, garlicky relief, while harissa vinaigrette adds smoky heat. The sumac cabbage contributes lemony brightness, and pickled onions cut through with sharp tanginess. The soft pita bread ties everything together, creating a balanced bite that is simultaneously spicy, creamy, and refreshing.
customize: Personalize your Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita by adjusting spice levels or swapping components. Request extra tzatziki for more cooling contrast or add additional toppings from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings). Consider adding feta cheese for saltiness or swapping the harissa for a milder dressing from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings). You can also build your own creation starting with bases and proteins for complete control.
pairsWell: Complement your Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita with sides that balance its bold flavors. CAVA's seasonal vegetables or lentil soup provide lighter accompaniments. For beverages, choose refreshing options from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) like mint lemonade or sparkling water. Consider adding a side of pita chips with hummus from the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) for sharing, or finish with a sweet treat from the desserts selection.
healthyChoice: While higher in calories at 810, this pita offers quality protein and nutrient-dense ingredients. The lamb provides iron and B vitamins, while vegetables contribute fiber and antioxidants. Tzatziki adds probiotics from yogurt. For lighter options, check the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) or customize portions. Those monitoring specific nutrients should consult the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed ingredient information and modifications.
howToOrder: Order the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it from the Curated Pitas section. Specify any modifications upfront, such as extra tzatziki or less harissa. For online orders, select the item and use customization options to adjust ingredients. In-store, team members can guide you through modifications. Consider pairing with a side and drink for a complete meal experience.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greek Chicken Pita at 720 calories and $12.95-$13.45, the lamb version offers bolder, spicier flavors with slightly higher calories. The Steak + Feta Pita ($15.45-$16.65, 820 cal) provides similar heartiness at a higher price. The Spicy Chicken + Avocado Pita (930 cal) delivers more calories, while the Crispy Falafel Pita offers a vegetarian alternative at 750 calories and lower cost.
worthTrying: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita deserves attention for its authentic Mediterranean flavors and quality ingredients. The combination of spiced lamb with cooling and tangy elements creates a memorable taste experience. At $13.95-$14.95, it represents good value for premium protein. Whether you are a lamb enthusiast or exploring new flavors, this pita showcases CAVA's commitment to bold, fresh cuisine worth experiencing firsthand.
whoShouldTry: This pita appeals to adventurous eaters who enjoy bold, spicy flavors and traditional Mediterranean cuisine. Lamb lovers seeking alternatives to typical chicken or beef options will appreciate the unique protein choice. Those with higher protein needs benefit from the 38g serving. Spice enthusiasts who enjoy harissa and complex flavor profiles should prioritize this selection. However, those avoiding red meat or preferring milder tastes might explore other curated pitas.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita contains 810 calories per serving, with 38g of protein, 66g of carbohydrates, and 44g of fat. This makes it one of the heartier options on the CAVA Curated Pitas menu, providing substantial energy and protein for a complete meal.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita is priced between $13.95 and $14.95, depending on location. This pricing reflects the premium lamb protein and carefully curated ingredient combination, positioning it in the mid-to-upper range of CAVA's pita offerings.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita by adjusting or removing ingredients. Request extra tzatziki, reduce the harissa vinaigrette for less heat, or add toppings like feta cheese. CAVA accommodates dietary preferences and allows modifications to suit your taste and nutritional requirements.

faqs.q: Is the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita very spicy?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita has moderate to bold heat from the Hot Harissa Vinaigrette and seasoned lamb meatballs. The tzatziki sauce provides cooling balance. If you prefer less spice, request light or no harissa, or substitute with a milder dressing to adjust the heat level to your preference.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita?
faqs.a: The Spicy Lamb Meatball Pita includes pita bread, spicy lamb meatballs, tzatziki sauce, sumac cabbage slaw, pickled onions, and Hot Harissa Vinaigrette. These Mediterranean-inspired ingredients combine to create layers of spicy, creamy, tangy, and fresh flavors in every bite.
